artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne
artworks.description: The Baroque marble that fixed Ovid's chase in stone — Daphne's toes rooting, Apollo's fingers on bark that was still flesh a heartbeat before.

artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne
artworks.description: National Gallery, London: Apollo pursues as laurel already sprouts from Daphne's raised hands — an early Renaissance courtly chase that crowns the nymph as the poet's tree.

artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne
artworks.description: Waterhouse freezes the riverbank flight: Daphne twists as bark and foliage claim her limbs, Apollo still reaching — Victorian classicist terror becoming green armour.

artworks.title: Apollo in Love with Daphne
artworks.description: Poussin's unfinished Louvre late masterpiece gathers the Ovidian episode into lucid classical landscape: Apollo pursues, Daphne flees toward her river-father, metamorphosis begins at the grove's edge.

artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne
artworks.description: Tiepolo lightens the chase into Venetian air: Apollo lunges as Daphne's fingers leaf into laurel — Ovid's panic restaged as Rococo luminous theatre.

music.title: Dafne
music.description: Peri's Dafne is often called the first opera — Daphne's flight from Apollo as the newborn art form's founding subject.

popCulture.title: Apollo and Daphne
popCulture.creator: Gian Lorenzo Bernini
popCulture.description: Bernini's Galleria Borghese marble remains the chase's modern emblem — bark racing up Daphne's body as Apollo reaches.
